notes: The source URL and text are for the Aviation Maintenance Technician Associate of Science Degree, not the Certificate of Achievement. The certificate's heading appears only in the navigation menu; its requirements are not in the text, so no blocks were recorded.

The A.S. section lists all twelve AERO courses (AERO 050-055 and 050L-055L) as Required Courses with Total Units 58, plus a GE pattern (SBVC GE or Cal-GETC) and a 60-unit minimum degree total. The certificate likely has the same 58-unit core; a reviewer should fetch the certificate page to confirm.
The A.S. page prints codes with a leading zero (AERO 050) where the closed list has AERO 50 for the lecture courses.
Program learning outcomes printed on the A.S. page were not recorded because it is not shown that the certificate shares them.
